verdict.rationale: Firstbase states directly that it tracks compliance requirements and deadlines and will file all annual reports and franchise tax reports on the founder's behalf (docs-7). A compliance dashboard shows per-state deadlines and actions (docs-6), so this is a managed service. Missing for 10: pricing and add-on details for the annual-report service, whether state filing fees are included, and independent or hands-on confirmation that Firstbase actually filed annual reports for users.
